differences.native: MySQL computes the day after installation with DATE_ADD(i.install_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY).
differences.app: SQLite computes the same date with date(i.install_dt, '+1 day').
differences.rationale: The installed SQL runner uses SQLite, which does not implement MySQL's DATE_ADD ... INTERVAL syntax. The CTE, join, aggregation, aliases, and grouping otherwise match exactly.
